description: FACT. Use this first when you need Snap's published creator-monetization rules themselves: thresholds, country lists, policy text, source URL, verified_at, and effective date. Do not use it to score one creator or to compute a shortfall. For a creator's numbers, use check_eligibility or calculate_gap.

inputSchema.description: FACT tool. Returns Snap's current creator-monetization requirements per program, each with source URL, verified_at, effective_date, status, applies_to (entry vs enrolled creators) and mvp_scope. Defaults to in-scope programs: unified_monetization_program, payouts, tax, snap_star, creator_monetization_policy, recommendation_eligibility, brand_partnerships, public_profile, plus historical records on request. Use check_eligibility/calculate_gap to compare a creator's metrics against the rules.

as_of.description: Return the rules that were in force on this date (uses version history). Default: today.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3, or an English country name. Adds country_eligibility. Does not remove facts.

include_out_of_scope.description: Include programs outside the MVP scope (e.g., lens_creator_rewards, creator_subscriptions). Default false. Requesting an out-of-scope program with this false returns PROGRAM_OUT_OF_SCOPE.

include_unverified.description: Include rules we could not verify (status=unverified). Default true so gaps in knowledge are visible.

anyOf.description: Program identifier. Validated at runtime against programs present in the rules database; unknown values return UNKNOWN_PROGRAM. Examples: unified_monetization_program, snap_star, creator_subscriptions, brand_partnerships, payouts, tax, recommendation_eligibility, creator_monetization_policy, public_profile, lens_creator_rewards.

program.description: Limit to one program. Omit for all programs.

allOf.description: Fields present in every successful tool output.

policy.description: Human-readable freshness policy, e.g. 'Sources are re-checked daily; rules not re-verified within 7 days are listed as stale.'

rules_db_version.description: Monotonic version of the published rules set. Pattern YYYY-MM-DD.n

stale_rule_ids.description: Rules in this response whose verified_at is older than the staleness window stated in `policy`.

notice.description: Non-affiliation notice included in every response.

warnings.description: Plain strings. Omitted when empty. Calculation tools add a string when followers is 0 and view_time_hours_28d or spotlight_view_time_hours_28d is above 0, and when view_time_hours_28d exceeds 28 days × 24 hours × followers × 0.5. Those warnings say the figure is unusually high for your follower count, please check for a typo, and that view time can come from non-followers. They are never an error. FACT GET aliases append ignored query parameter notices to this same array. Spotlight hours above total view hours are HTTP 400 VALUE_INCONSISTENT rather than a warning.

catalog_scope.description: Counts computed from the approved rules database for one as-of date. mvp_in_force is the default requirements list. in_force_including_out_of_scope adds programs stored as out of scope. mvp_including_historical is every in-scope record, which is what the rule-change log lists.

direct_answer.description: Answer-first lead built from entry-requirement facts included in this response. Omitted when those facts are absent.

direct_answer_note.description: Optional sentence after the lead for unverified entry facts left out of it. Omitted when there are none.

items.description: FACT: a rule record as stored in the versioned rules database (approved records only).

changed_after.description: Inclusive start of an observed change window when the source does not state a single effective_date. Null when unknown. Additive.

changed_before.description: Inclusive end of an observed change window when the source does not state a single effective_date. Null when unknown. Additive.

date_note.description: How changed_after and changed_before were established. Null when there is no window note. Not a substitute for source_url.

effective_date_note.description: Present when effective_date is null because Snap did not publish a date. effective_date stays null.

iso_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 codes for each name in a country list, from the reviewed country map. Omitted unless this fact is a country list.
